eligibility_rationale: Multiple standardized floral traits have treatment-specific total selection under open versus supplemental pollination; fruit herbivory is measured on the same plants but not experimentally decomposed into a matched trait-specific antagonist component.

Multiple floral traits have treatment-specific total selection under open versus supplemental pollination with seed-predator damage measured; same-axis repeated total-selection contexts are available but the antagonist component is not experimentally isolated.

Multiple floral traits are evaluated under open versus pollen-supplemented contexts across years with natural florivore/herbivore damage measured; repeated total-selection axes are available but two-function component geometry remains bounded.

Multiple floral traits have total selection estimated under ambient, reduced-pollinator, and reduced-pollinator-plus-herbivory contexts; ecological components are manipulated but the design is not a complete independent two-factor decomposition of trait-specific functional components.
